source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: A downgrade may proceed for any membership level if the item has not yet shipped; if the item has already shipped, Gold, Silver, and Bronze members receive a credit for the shipping fee, but Guest members receive nothing.
Overnight shipping upgrade fees are gated by membership: Gold members have the $20 fee waived; Guest, Bronze, and Silver members must be charged $20.

An upgrade to overnight shipping is permitted to proceed only in the event that shipping status is Order Received; if the item has already shipped (In Transit, Out for Delivery, or Delivered), the ship date cannot be altered and the upgrade request is required to be denied.
Before processing a shipping upgrade or downgrade, the agent must verify identity using full name, account ID, order ID, and phone number via Verify Identity.
